title: VolCo: Volumetric Contact for High-Fidelity Human Grasp Generation
title_zh: VolCo：用于高保真人手抓取生成的体积接触模型

paragraphs.en: Accurate contact modeling is fundamental to understanding hand–object interaction, yet existing contact representations are typically restricted to object surfaces and rely on hand - crafted rules to recover contact details, leading to severe penetrations and implausible results. To better exploit the rich detail in motion - capture data, we introduce Vol umetric Co ntact (VolCo), a representation that expands surface points to a set of 3D volumetric grids. VolCo encodes 3D contact that allows precise hand part recovery, and is organized in an inherent hierarchy: local contact details within each volume and global hand geometry across all volumes. Our framework, VolCoDiff, employs two modules to capture local and global features following this hierarchy. For local contact details, we use a 3D variational autoencoder to model the possible hand configurations conditioned on the local object signed distance field (SDF). For global hand geometry, we design a prior - guided diffusion model that learns the distribution of compressed latent features aggregated from the volumetric grids. We evaluate our method on two benchmark datasets and demonstrate state - of - the - art performance in penetration and stability, indicating the capability to generate tight grasps with much less severe penetrations. Our code is available at https://github.com/chzh9311/volco .

paragraphs.en: Existing methods mostly rely on hand-crafted rules in test-time-adaptation (TTA) to control penetrations [ 11 ] . Such TTA has limited adaptivity since the rules rely on object surface shapes. As shown in Fig. 1 , penetration losses based on nearest-neighbor (NN) queries is non-robust, changing gradient directions when the point crosses the medium line. Moreover, slight penetrations are expected at contact regions with rigid models like MANO, but this method cannot control the exact penetration depth. Consequently, some generated grasps still show severe penetrations and limited plausibility.
paragraphs.zh: 现有方法在测试时自适应（TTA）中主要依赖人工设计的规则来控制穿入 [ 11 ]。 这类 TTA 的适应性有限，因为其规则依赖于物体表面的形状。 如图 1 所示，基于最近邻（NN）查询的穿入损失并不稳健，当点穿过介质线时，梯度方向会发生变化。 此外，对于像 MANO 这样的刚性模型，接触区域本应存在轻微穿入，但该方法无法控制确切的穿入深度。 因此，某些生成的抓取动作仍存在严重的穿入问题，且合理性有限。

paragraphs.en: Our target is to retain the fine-grained contact details from training data to the largest extent, thus reducing severe penetrations and improving geometric plausibility. Our insight is that the points to reason contact, i.e.,contact points, should not only lie on the object surface, but should be scattered around the surface. In this way, the contact can cover much larger area of the hand and preserve the exact penetration depth, thus no rules with NN queries are required. Further, as 3D grid representations [ 34 , 43 , 27 ] are limited by computational cost [ 25 ] , these points should be hierarchically organized to find the balance between computational cost and granularity.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的目标是尽可能保留训练数据中的精细接触细节，从而减少严重的穿透问题并提升几何合理性。 我们的见解是，需要推理的接触点，即接触点，不仅应位于物体表面，还应分散在表面周围。 通过这种方式，接触区域可以覆盖手部更大的范围，同时保持精确的穿透深度，因此无需使用基于最近邻查询的规则。 此外，由于三维网格表示 [ 34 , 43 , 27 ] 受计算成本 [ 25 ] 的限制，这些点应进行分层组织，以在计算成本和精细程度之间找到平衡。

paragraphs.en: To this end, we introduce Vol umetric Co ntact (VolCo), a novel contact representation constructed from local volumetric grids whose centers are uniformly sampled on the object surface, inspired by Mosaic-SDF [ 42 ] . While Mosaic-SDF employs such local volumes to represent general object geometry via signed distance values, VolCo extends the paradigm to contact modeling of a fixed topology (hand) by capturing also the correspondences. Specifically, each point in a volume encodes the contact likelihood and the correspondence using Continuous Surface Embeddings (CSE) [ 28 ] . Furthermore, VolCo aggregates point-level features within each local volume. This coherent hierarchy allows the separate modeling of local configurations and global hand priors. Based on the hierarchy, we present a volume-wise latent diffusion model i.e.,VolCoDiff, consisting of a 3DVAE i.e.,VolumeVAE and a latent diffusion model based on Scene Diffuser [ 15 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 为此，我们提出了体积接触表示（VolCo），这是一种新颖的接触表示方法。它由局部体积网格构建而成，这些网格的中心在物体表面上均匀采样，其灵感来自 Mosaic-SDF [42]。 虽然 Mosaic-SDF 利用此类局部体积通过符号距离值来表示通用物体几何形状，但 VolCo 将这一范式扩展到了具有固定拓扑结构（手部）的接触建模中，同时还能捕捉对应关系。 具体来说，体积中的每个点都使用连续表面嵌入（CSE）[28] 来编码接触可能性与对应关系。 此外，VolCo 还会在每个局部体积内聚合点级特征。 这种连贯的层次结构使得局部配置和全局手部先验能够被分别建模。 基于这一层次结构，我们提出了一种基于体积的潜在扩散模型，即 VolCoDiff，它由一个三维变分自编码器（3DVAE），即 VolumeVAE，以及一个基于 Scene Diffuser [15] 的潜在扩散模型组成。

paragraphs.en: VolumeVAE aggregates the common prior over local volumes conditioned on the SDF values, modeling what hand surface configurations are geometrically possible within each volume . Since each volume is small ( 2 3 2^{3} cm \mathrm{cm} ), the feasible configuration space is limited in scale and thus possible to be compressed to a compact latent code. VolumeVAE abstracts away the fine-grained surface geometry, allowing the diffusion model to focus solely on the global hand prior.
paragraphs.zh: VolumeVAE 聚合了以 SDF 值为条件的局部体积上的通用先验，从而模拟出每个体积内哪些手部表面构型在几何上是可行的。 由于每个体积都很小（2^3 cm），可行构型空间的规模有限，因此可以将其压缩为一个紧凑的潜在编码。 VolumeVAE 抽象掉了精细的表面几何结构，使扩散模型能够完全专注于全局手部先验。

paragraphs.en: The latent diffusion model is trained to capture what combinations of local hand configurations constitute a plausible grasp . This objective is governed by two key principles. First, all local hand parts must be reachable by a valid hand. To enforce this, an auxiliary branch is incorporated in the diffusion UNet to predict the hand pose, which is subsequently mapped to VolCo latent space to supervise the generated contact. Second, the grasp should be stable . Due to the joint encoding of SDFs and contact likelihood, VolCo allows the explicit contact force inference via a spring-damper model, and thus a force-aware stability loss can be applied [ 6 ] . Together, these two principles encourage the generation of physically plausible hand part combinations, while VolumeVAE ensures all local penetrations remain within plausible bounds. Finally, the generated grasp is obtained by initializing with the hand-branch prediction and subsequently fitting it to the generated VolCo representation.
paragraphs.zh: 潜在扩散模型经过训练，能够捕捉哪些局部手部配置的组合构成一个合理的抓握。 这一目标由两个关键原则决定。 首先，所有局部手部部分都必须能被一个有效的手部所触及。 为实现这一点，在扩散 UNet 中引入了一个辅助分支来预测手部姿态，随后将其映射到 VolCo 潜在空间，以监督生成的接触。 其次，抓握应当稳定。 由于 SDF 和接触可能性的联合编码，VolCo 允许通过弹簧-阻尼器模型显式推断接触力，因此可以应用一种感知力的稳定性损失 [6]。 这两个原则共同促进了物理上合理的局部手部组合的生成，而 VolumeVAE 则确保所有局部穿透保持在合理的范围内。 最后，生成的抓握通过以手部分支预测作为初始化，并随后将其拟合到生成的 VolCo 表示中来获得。

VolCo shows the highest precision, indicating its capability to preserve the maximum hand information. We also benchmark the grasp generation capability on two public datasets, and our method achieves the highest stability, lowest penetration depth, and highest plausible contact area. paragraphs.en: Contact Modeling . Contact modeling has shown great potential in hand-object estimation and generation [ 17 , 11 ] . Early approaches define contact as per-point likelihood on the object surface [ 11 , 17 , 36 ] , providing guidance on grasp location but leaving a substantial information gap to complete hand meshes. Later, the contact maps get enriched by including part / anchor label [ 40 , 27 , 49 ] , hand continuous surface embedding [ 28 , 44 ] , part orientations [ 24 ] , and contact forces [ 6 ] . Nevertheless, all such representations remain confined to the object surface and lack explicit modeling of penetration depth, leaving its recovery hand-crafted rules.
paragraphs.zh: 接触建模。 接触建模在手-物体估计与生成方面展现出巨大潜力 [ 17 , 11 ] 。 早期的方法将接触定义为物体表面的点状概率 [ 11 , 17 , 36 ] ，虽然为抓取位置提供了指导，但仍然存在显著的信息缺失，无法完成手部网格的构建。 随后，通过引入部件/锚点标签 [ 40 , 27 , 49 ] 、手部连续表面嵌入 [ 28 , 44 ] 、部件朝向 [ 24 ] 以及接触力 [ 6 ] ，接触图得到了进一步丰富。 然而，所有这些表示形式仍然局限于物体表面，缺乏对穿透深度的显式建模，因此其恢复过程仍需依赖人工设计的规则。

paragraphs.en: 3D Hand-Object Representations . Some recent methods use implicit functions [ 19 , 5 ] or 3D volumetric grids (Bases Point Set [ 34 , 27 ] or SDF [ 43 , 5 ] ) to represent both hands and objects, thus relating them in a common feature space. Such representations effectively capture relations between hands and objects, but are limited in fitting to known templates or low resolution [ 25 ] . On contrary, VolCo is rooted on known templates and finds the balance of fine-details and computational cost.
paragraphs.zh: 3D 手-物体表示。 一些近期方法使用隐式函数 [ 19 , 5 ] 或 3D 体素网格（基础点集 [ 34 , 27 ] 或 SDF [ 43 , 5 ]）来表示手和物体，从而将它们关联到共同的特征空间中。 这类表示能有效捕捉手与物体之间的关系，但在拟合已知模板或低分辨率方面存在局限性 [ 25 ]。 相反，VolCo 基于已知模板，并在精细细节与计算成本之间找到了平衡。

paragraphs.en: Human Grasp Generation . Human Grasp Generation methods have evolved significantly in recent years. Early methods [ 18 , 24 , 46 ] utilize cVAE [ 20 ] as the backbone, but are limited by the capacity and posterior collapse [ 1 ] of VAEs. Subsequent research [ 33 , 44 , 49 , 3 , 23 ] gradually shifts to diffusion models [ 14 ] , with latent diffusion models [ 31 ] recently taking dominance. The compressed latent space can reduce the number of parameters [ 49 ] and restrict pose plausibility [ 21 ] . Nevertheless, these methods lay their attention on global hand pose, ignoring the contact details. Another line of work try to recover the contact first, then fit the hand to the contact maps [ 40 , 17 , 47 , 24 , 27 , 6 ] . However, due to the incomplete and non-deterministic nature of the contact representations, the optimization requires NN based penetration losses [ 32 ] and risks getting stuck in local minima.
paragraphs.zh: 人类抓握生成。 近年来，人类抓握生成方法取得了显著进展。 早期方法 [ 18 , 24 , 46 ] 使用 cVAE [ 20 ] 作为主干模型，但受限于 VAE 的容量和后验坍塌问题 [ 1 ]。 后续研究 [ 33 , 44 , 49 , 3 , 23 ] 逐渐转向扩散模型 [ 14 ]，而潜在扩散模型 [ 31 ] 近期占据了主导地位。 压缩后的潜在空间可以减少参数数量 [ 49 ]，并限制姿态的合理性 [ 21 ]。 然而，这些方法主要关注全局手部姿态，忽略了接触细节。 另一类研究尝试先恢复接触信息，再将手部拟合到接触图上 [ 40 , 17 , 47 , 24 , 27 , 6 ]。 但由于接触表示具有不完全性和非确定性，优化过程需要基于神经网络的穿透损失 [ 32 ]，并存在陷入局部最优的风险。

paragraphs.en: To minimize the range of latent vectors, we set all volumes without hand vertices inside to zero, which are mapped to a constant latent. The resulting latent is a matrix Z c ∈ ℝ N × 128 Z^{c}\in\mathbb{R}^{N\times 128} . This volume-wise latent space integrates naturally with Scene Diffuser [ 15 ] , a point-conditioned diffusion framework. Inspired by [ 23 ] , we use the flattened Mosaic-SDF as the feature vector and utilize the PointNet [ 29 ] encoder to extract the per-point features. These features are used as the positional encoding in the attention-based UNet.
paragraphs.zh: 为了最小化潜在向量的范围，我们将内部没有手部顶点的所有体素设为零，这些体素被映射到一个恒定的潜在值。 由此得到的潜在值是一个矩阵 Z c ∈ ℝ N × 128 Z^{c}\in\mathbb{R}^{N\times 128}。 这种基于体素的潜在空间能够自然地与 Scene Diffuser [ 15 ] 集成，后者是一种以点为条件的扩散框架。 受 [ 23 ] 的启发，我们将扁平化的 Mosaic-SDF 用作特征向量，并利用 PointNet [ 29 ] 编码器提取每个点的特征。 这些特征被用作注意力机制 UNet 中的位置编码。

paragraphs.en: We test the correspondence and contact representations together with comparisons to previous representations on GRAB test set every 64 frames. Three criteria are utilized following previous research [ 48 , 13 , 24 ] : 1) End Point Error (EPE) —average Euclidean distance of mesh vertices; 2) F-score —harmonic average of precision and recall between vertices of two meshes under certain threshold(5 mm \mathrm{mm} and 15 mm \mathrm{mm} ); 3) Area Under the ROC Curve (AUC) [ 9 ] expanding from 0 to 5 cm \mathrm{cm} . All hands are aligned to the objects. The resulting poses are obtained via optimization, initialized by the best 6D poses that fit the average hand to the contact. See Appendix C.3 for initialization details.
paragraphs.zh: 我们每 64 帧在 GRAB 测试集上同时测试对应关系和接触表示，并与先前的表示进行比较。 遵循以往研究 [ 48 , 13 , 24 ] ，我们采用了三个标准：1) 端点误差 (EPE) —网格顶点的平均欧几里得距离；2) F 分数 —在特定阈值（5 mm \mathrm{mm} 和 15 mm \mathrm{mm} ）下，两个网格顶点之间精确率和召回率的调和平均值；3) ROC 曲线下面积 (AUC) [ 9 ] ，范围从 0 到 5 cm \mathrm{cm} 。 所有手都与物体对齐。 最终得到的姿态通过优化获得，其初始值由能将平均手与接触点最佳拟合的 6D 姿态确定。 初始化细节请参见附录 C.3。

paragraphs.en: Metrics . Following previous research [ 17 , 24 , 38 , 6 ] , we utilize multiple criteria to evaluate stability, geometric plausibility and diversity of the generation. 1) Simulation Displacement (SD) measures the displacement of object center of mass in PyBullet [ 8 ] simulation; 2) Penetration Depth (PD) measures the average of all samples’ deepest penetration depth; 3) Intersection Volume (IV) is calculated by voxelizing the object meshes to 1 mm 3 1\text{\,}\mathrm{m}\mathrm{m}^{3} and counting the overlapping voxels. 3) Contact Ratio (CR) reflects the ratio of samples in contact. To indicate the tightness of grasps, we introduce Contact Area (CA) to measure the valid contact area on the object surface (See Appendix. C.4 ). 4) Entropy and Cluster Size measure the diversity of generation.
paragraphs.zh: 指标。遵循先前的研究 [17, 24, 38, 6]，我们采用多种标准来评估生成的稳定性、几何合理性及多样性。1) 模拟位移（SD）用于衡量物体在 PyBullet [8] 模拟中的质心位移；2) 穿透深度（PD）用于衡量所有样本中最大穿透深度的平均值；3) 相交体积（IV）通过将物体网格进行 1 mm³ 的体素化，并统计重叠的体素数量来计算；4) 接触比（CR）反映了处于接触状态的样本比例。为了表示抓握的紧密程度，我们引入了接触面积（CA），用于衡量物体表面的有效接触区域（参见附录 C.4）。5) 熵和簇大小用于衡量生成的多样性。

paragraphs.en: Quantitative Analysis . The results on both datasets are reported in Tab. 2 and 3 along with 1-sigma error bars. On the in-domain GRAB dataset, our method achieves the lowest SD and PD with the largest CA, exceeding the previous state-of-the-art by 14.8%, 32.5%, and 1.6%, respectively. This demonstrates that the generated grasps are stable, plausible, and contact-rich — whereas previous methods often collapse to similar poses in exchange for less penetration. On the out-of-domain HO3D dataset, our method surpasses the previous state-of-the-art by 12.3% (SD), 28.5% (PD), 18.2% (CA), demonstrating strong generalization to unseen objects. Despite HO3D objects being generally larger than those in GRAB, our method retains strong adaptability to these scales.
paragraphs.zh: 定量分析。 两个数据集上的结果均列于表 2 和表 3 中，并附有 1-sigma 误差棒。 在领域内 GRAB 数据集上，我们的方法实现了最低的 SD 和 PD 以及最高的 CA，分别比此前的最优方法高出 14.8%、32.5% 和 1.6%。 这表明所生成的抓取姿态稳定、合理且接触点丰富——而此前的方法往往以减少穿模为代价，导致姿态趋于相似。 在领域外 HO3D 数据集上，我们的方法比此前的最优方法分别高出 12.3%（SD）、28.5%（PD）和 18.2%（CA），展现出对未见物体的强大泛化能力。 尽管 HO3D 中的物体通常比 GRAB 中的物体更大，但我们的方法仍能很好地适应这些尺寸差异。

paragraphs.en: Qualitative Analysis . We compare our method qualitatively with previous state-of-the-art methods in penetrations [ 24 , 38 ] and stability [ 6 ] in Fig. 5 . The figure highlights the contact details, where previous methods tend to generate loose grasps due to aggressive penetration losses or implausibly deep penetrations especially in thin objects like wineglass and mug. This is due to the non-differentiable penetration loss with NN query. Our method, on contrast, finds a good balance of grasping steadiness and penetration—penetrations are common but mostly not severe, just like in the original motion capture data, indicating higher geometric plausibility. This also explains the lower penetration depth and higher penetration volumes, as our model prefers tight grasps with larger contact areas. More generated grasps are available in Appendix D .

paragraphs.en: Point-based contact yields weak stability due to incomplete contact details and hand-crafted rules. Switching to VolCo ( 1 → 2 1\rightarrow 2 ) obviously improves stability. Adding prior guidance ( 2 → 4 ; 3 → 5 2\rightarrow 4;3\rightarrow 5 ) greatly decreases penetration depth, and increases IV and CA, while adding initial guess ( 4 → 5 ; 6 → 7 4\rightarrow 5;6\rightarrow 7 ) further improves stability and CA, highlighting the dual role of the auxiliary branch: it regularizes generated VolCo during training to allow being fitted by MANO with less penetrations, and provides better initialization during testing to fit larger contact areas. Interestingly, the stability loss reduce displacement obviously only when there is prior guidance ( 4 → 6 ; 5 → 7 4\rightarrow 6;5\rightarrow 7 ), suggesting geometric plausibility is a prerequisite for physical stability.
paragraphs.zh: 基于点的接触方式由于接触细节不完整且规则为人工制定，导致稳定性较弱。 切换到 VolCo（1 → 2）显然能提升稳定性。 添加先验引导（2 → 4；3 → 5）可显著降低穿透深度，并提高 IV 和 CA；而加入初始猜测（4 → 5；6 → 7）则进一步提升了稳定性和 CA，这凸显了辅助分支的双重作用：它在训练过程中对生成的 VolCo 进行正则化，使其能被 MANO 以更少的穿透拟合；在测试时则提供更优的初始化，以拟合更大的接触区域。 有趣的是，只有当存在先验引导（4 → 6；5 → 7）时，稳定性损失才会明显减少位移，这表明几何合理性是物理稳定性的前提条件。

paragraphs.en: In this section, we analyze the trade-off between efficiency and performance against prior methods. Table. 5 reports a detailed runtime breakdown, with all experiments run on a single RTX 4090 GPU. Our method achieves the best simulation displacement and penetration depth among all compared methods. VAE-based methods need only a single forward pass at inference, while diffusion-based methods require iterative denoising, so the latter are slower. Among diffusion-based methods, ours has the second-fastest inference time. Its optimization time is also the second fastest overall, behind only the point-contact baseline [ 23 ] . Additionally, reducing the resolution from 128 × 8 3 128\times 8^{3} to 64 × 4 3 64\times 4^{3} has little effect on efficiency, suggesting the preference for the normal resolution.

paragraphs.en: However, the point-contact baseline shows obvious drawback in batched inference. Although our method has more parameters (74.04M vs. 24.41M) and higher peak memory (358.1M vs. 191.4M), it achieves substantially lower TFLOPs (2.01 vs. 13.2). The major source of computation is the UNet attention blocks which scales as O ⁡ ( N ) O(N) in token count, not the volumetric representation due VAE compression. Thus our inference time barely changes as the number of samples increases from 1 to 10 (5.28 s \mathrm{s} → \rightarrow 5.47 s \mathrm{s} ), but the time of baseline increases substantially (2.90 s \mathrm{s} → \rightarrow 19.57 s \mathrm{s} ).
paragraphs.zh: 然而，点接触基线方法在批量推理方面存在明显缺陷。 尽管我们的方法参数更多（74.04M 对比 24.41M），峰值内存占用也更高（358.1M 对比 191.4M），但其 TFLOPs 值却显著更低（2.01 对比 13.2）。 计算的主要来源是 UNet 注意力块，其计算量随令牌数量呈 O(N) 增长，而非由 VAE 压缩带来的体素表示。 因此，当样本数从 1 增加到 10 时，我们的推理时间几乎不变（5.28 s → 5.47 s），而基线方法的推理时间则大幅上升（2.90 s → 19.57 s）。

paragraphs.en: We propose VolCo, a novel volumetric contact representation that faithfully preserves fine-grained details in hand-object contact. Building on VolCo, we present VolCoDiff, a volume-wise latent diffusion model, in which the local details are handled by VolumeVAE and the global composition of hand configurations is mitigated by diffusion. The experiments demonstrate the highest precision in reconstruction from contact and the state-of-the-art geometric plausibility and stability in grasp generation, emphasizing the value of introducing hierarchical contact volumes.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 VolCo，一种新颖的体积接触表示方法，能够忠实地保留手与物体接触处的精细细节。 基于 VolCo，我们提出了 VolCoDiff，这是一种基于体积的潜在扩散模型，其中局部细节由 VolumeVAE 处理，而手部构型的整体组合则通过扩散机制得到优化。 实验结果表明，该方法在从接触状态进行重建时具有最高的精度，并且在抓取生成方面实现了当前最先进的几何合理性和稳定性，凸显了引入分层接触体积的重要性。

paragraphs.en: Limitations . Our method is currently limited in controllability and scale adaptivity. paragraphs.en: VolumeVAE adopts a symmetric 3D VAE architecture, illustrated in Fig. 6 . The input VolCo and object SDF volumes are passed through two downsampling stages, flattened, and processed by residual MLP blocks followed by a projection layer to yield a 1D feature vector. paragraphs.en: For training, we adopt the GRAB dataset [ 34 ] with the same pre-processing pipeline as GrabNet, yielding 323,622 frames of closely interacting hand-object pairs. The validation and test sets are obtained by downsampling every 4 and 64 frames, comprising 7,757 and 1,012 frames, respectively. The training set is used directly for training the diffusion model, and the test set is used in the experiment of reconstruction from contact. Further, the training set is augmented by a randomly selected rotation from all 24 axis-aligned ones which is applied to the local volumes. This keeps the rotated volumes still axis-aligned so no interpolations are needed. The resulting Mosaic-SDF and VolCo can be efficiently obtained by reordering the grid points.
paragraphs.zh: 在训练阶段，我们采用 GRAB 数据集 [34]，并使用与 GrabNet 相同的预处理流程，从而获得 323,622 帧紧密互动手-物体对。 验证集和测试集通过每隔 4 帧和 64 帧进行下采样得到，分别包含 7,757 帧和 1,012 帧。 训练集直接用于训练扩散模型，而测试集则用于从接触状态进行重建的实验。 此外，我们通过从所有 24 个轴对齐旋转中随机选择一个旋转来增强训练集，并将其应用于局部体素。 这样处理可以确保旋转后的体素仍然保持轴对齐，因此无需进行插值。 最终的 Mosaic-SDF 和 VolCo 可以通过重新排列网格点高效地获得。

paragraphs.en: However, the training of VolumeVAE requires special attention. The key concern is that one training sample of VolumeVAE should be one single volume with object SDF and contact values. paragraphs.zh: 然而，VolumeVAE 的训练需要特别注意。 关键问题在于，VolumeVAE 的每个训练样本都应是一个包含对象 SDF 和接触值的单个体素。 因此，我们基于采样点构建了一个局部体素数据集。 每个对象表面采样了 1,024 个点，因此总共可获得 3.314 亿个局部体素用于训练。 该数据集的规模超过了紧凑型 VAE 模型的容量，且其中很大一部分数据包含冗余或重复信息。 因此，我们在数据预处理阶段采用了两级下采样方法。

paragraphs.en: To mitigate the similar poses between continuous frames, we downsample the training set every 5 frames, and validation and test set every 10 frames; To reduce the redundancy of nearby sampled points, we also downsample the object points each frame by 40% (training set) and 20% (validation and testing). Since in our VolCoDiff, non-contact volumes are set to 0, so fitting to those volumes in training is not necessary. Thus, we only take the sampled volumes with at least one hand vertex inside to construct the dataset. Finally, we arrive at a training set of 7,320,315 volumes, a validation set of 165,651 and a test set of 273,315.
paragraphs.zh: 为了缓解连续帧之间相似姿态的问题，我们对训练集每 5 帧进行一次下采样，对验证集和测试集则每 10 帧进行一次下采样；为了减少邻近采样点的冗余性，我们还对每一帧的物体点进行了下采样，其中训练集下采样 40%，验证集和测试集下采样 20%。 由于在我们的 VolCoDiff 中，非接触体积被设为 0，因此无需在训练过程中对这些体积进行拟合。 因此，我们仅选取至少有一个手部顶点位于其内部的采样体积来构建数据集。 最终，我们得到了一个包含 7,320,315 个体积的训练集、一个包含 165,651 个体的验证集以及一个包含 273,315 个体的测试集。

paragraphs.en: Depending on the contribution, reproducibility can be accomplished in various ways. sents.en: In the case of closed-source models, it may be that access to the model is limited in some way (e.g., to registered users), but it should be possible for other researchers to have some path to reproducing or verifying the results.
sents.zh: 对于闭源模型，其访问权限可能在某些方面受到限制（例如，仅限注册用户），但其他研究人员仍应能够找到某种途径来复现或验证研究结果。

paragraphs.en: Question: Does the paper provide open access to the data and code, with sufficient instructions to faithfully reproduce the main experimental results, as described in supplemental material?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：论文是否对数据和代码提供了开放获取，并附有足以忠实复现主要实验结果的说明（如补充材料所述）？

paragraphs.en: Justification: The code will be released upon accepted.
paragraphs.zh: 理由：代码将在接受后发布。

paragraphs.en: The answer [N/A] means that paper does not include experiments requiring code.
paragraphs.zh: 答案 [N/A] 表示该论文不包含需要代码的实验。

paragraphs.en: Please see the NeurIPS code and data submission guidelines ( https://neurips.cc/public/guides/CodeSubmissionPolicy ) for more details.
paragraphs.zh: 有关更多详细信息，请参阅 NeurIPS 的代码和数据提交指南（https://neurips.cc/public/guides/CodeSubmissionPolicy）。

paragraphs.en: While we encourage the release of code and data, we understand that this might not be possible, so [No] is an acceptable answer. Papers cannot be rejected simply for not including code, unless this is central to the contribution (e.g., for a new open-source benchmark).
paragraphs.zh: 虽然我们鼓励发布代码和数据，但我们理解这可能并非可行，因此选择 [否] 也是可以接受的答案。 论文不能仅仅因为没有包含代码而被拒绝，除非代码是贡献的核心部分（例如，针对一个新的开源基准测试）。

sents.en: While we encourage the release of code and data, we understand that this might not be possible, so [No] is an acceptable answer.
sents.zh: 虽然我们鼓励发布代码和数据，但我们理解这可能并非可行，因此选择 [否] 也是可以接受的答案。

sents.en: Papers cannot be rejected simply for not including code, unless this is central to the contribution (e.g., for a new open-source benchmark).
sents.zh: 论文不能仅仅因为没有包含代码而被拒绝，除非代码是贡献的核心部分（例如，针对一个新的开源基准测试）。

paragraphs.en: The instructions should contain the exact command and environment needed to run to reproduce the results. See the NeurIPS code and data submission guidelines ( https://neurips.cc/public/guides/CodeSubmissionPolicy ) for more details.
paragraphs.zh: 说明中应包含运行所需的确切命令和环境，以便重现结果。 更多详情请参阅 NeurIPS 的代码和数据提交指南（https://neurips.cc/public/guides/CodeSubmissionPolicy）。

sents.en: The instructions should contain the exact command and environment needed to run to reproduce the results.
sents.zh: 说明中应包含运行所需的确切命令和环境，以便重现结果。

sents.en: See the NeurIPS code and data submission guidelines ( https://neurips.cc/public/guides/CodeSubmissionPolicy ) for more details.
sents.zh: 更多详情请参阅 NeurIPS 的代码和数据提交指南（https://neurips.cc/public/guides/CodeSubmissionPolicy）。

paragraphs.en: The authors should provide instructions on data access and preparation, including how to access the raw data, preprocessed data, intermediate data, and generated data, etc.
paragraphs.zh: 作者应提供有关数据访问和准备的说明，包括如何获取原始数据、预处理数据、中间数据和生成数据等。

paragraphs.en: The authors should provide scripts to reproduce all experimental results for the new proposed method and baselines. If only a subset of experiments are reproducible, they should state which ones are omitted from the script and why.
paragraphs.zh: 作者应提供脚本，以便复现新提出的方法以及基线方法的所有实验结果。 如果仅有一部分实验可以复现，他们应说明哪些实验未被包含在脚本中及其原因。

sents.en: The authors should provide scripts to reproduce all experimental results for the new proposed method and baselines.
sents.zh: 作者应提供脚本，以便复现新提出的方法以及基线方法的所有实验结果。

sents.en: If only a subset of experiments are reproducible, they should state which ones are omitted from the script and why.
sents.zh: 如果仅有一部分实验可以复现，他们应说明哪些实验未被包含在脚本中及其原因。

paragraphs.en: At submission time, to preserve anonymity, the authors should release anonymized versions (if applicable).
paragraphs.zh: 提交时，为保持匿名性，作者应发布经过匿名处理的版本（如适用）。

paragraphs.en: Providing as much information as possible in supplemental material (appended to the paper) is recommended, but including URLs to data and code is permitted.
paragraphs.zh: 建议在补充材料（附于论文之后）中尽可能提供更多信息，但也可以包含数据和代码的 URL。

paragraphs.en: Question: Does the paper specify all the training and test details (e.g., data splits, hyperparameters, how they were chosen, type of optimizer) necessary to understand the results?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：该论文是否说明了理解研究结果所需的所有训练和测试细节（例如，数据划分、超参数及其选择方式、优化器类型）？

paragraphs.en: Justification: The hyperparameters are given in Methodology section, with brief motivations on choosing these parameters. Mostly, the hyperparameters are selected following previous works.
paragraphs.zh: 理由：超参数在“方法论”部分给出，并简要说明了选择这些参数的原因。 大多数情况下，超参数的选择遵循了先前的研究。

sents.en: Justification: The hyperparameters are given in Methodology section, with brief motivations on choosing these parameters.
sents.zh: 理由：超参数在“方法论”部分给出，并简要说明了选择这些参数的原因。

sents.en: Mostly, the hyperparameters are selected following previous works.
sents.zh: 大多数情况下，超参数的选择遵循了先前的研究。

paragraphs.en: The experimental setting should be presented in the core of the paper to a level of detail that is necessary to appreciate the results and make sense of them.
paragraphs.zh: 实验设置应在论文的核心部分以足够的细节呈现，以便读者能够理解并正确解读研究结果。

paragraphs.en: The full details can be provided either with the code, in appendix, or as supplemental material.
paragraphs.zh: 完整细节可以通过代码、附录或补充材料提供。

paragraphs.en: Question: Does the paper report error bars suitably and correctly defined or other appropriate information about the statistical significance of the experiments?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：该论文是否恰当且正确地报告了误差棒，或提供了关于实验统计显著性的其他适当信息？

paragraphs.en: Justification: The results reported in the main tables Tab. 2 and 3 are accompanied with error bars indicating the standard deviation (1-sigma).
paragraphs.zh: 说明：主表 Tab. 2 和 Tab. 3 中报告的结果均附有表示标准差（1-σ）的误差棒。

paragraphs.en: The authors should answer [Yes] if the results are accompanied by error bars, confidence intervals, or statistical significance tests, at least for the experiments that support the main claims of the paper.
paragraphs.zh: 如果研究结果附有误差棒、置信区间或统计显著性检验（至少对于支持论文主要论点的实验而言），作者应选择[是]。

paragraphs.en: The factors of variability that the error bars are capturing should be clearly stated (for example, train/test split, initialization, random drawing of some parameter, or overall run with given experimental conditions).
paragraphs.zh: 误差棒所反映的变异性因素应明确说明（例如，训练/测试划分、初始化、某些参数的随机抽取，或在给定实验条件下的整体运行）。

paragraphs.en: The method for calculating the error bars should be explained (closed form formula, call to a library function, bootstrap, etc.)
paragraphs.zh: 应说明误差棒的计算方法（闭式公式、调用库函数、自助法等）。

paragraphs.en: The assumptions made should be given (e.g., Normally distributed errors).
paragraphs.zh: 所采用的假设应予以说明（例如，误差服从正态分布）。

paragraphs.en: It should be clear whether the error bar is the standard deviation or the standard error of the mean.
paragraphs.zh: 应当明确误差棒代表的是标准差还是均值的标准误。

paragraphs.en: It is OK to report 1-sigma error bars, but one should state it. The authors should preferably report a 2-sigma error bar than state that they have a 96% CI, if the hypothesis of Normality of errors is not verified.
paragraphs.zh: 报告 1-σ 误差棒是可以的，但应当明确说明这一点。 如果未验证误差的正态性假设，作者最好报告 2-σ 误差棒，而不是声称其置信区间为 96%。

sents.en: It is OK to report 1-sigma error bars, but one should state it.
sents.zh: 报告 1-σ 误差棒是可以的，但应当明确说明这一点。

sents.en: The authors should preferably report a 2-sigma error bar than state that they have a 96% CI, if the hypothesis of Normality of errors is not verified.
sents.zh: 如果未验证误差的正态性假设，作者最好报告 2-σ 误差棒，而不是声称其置信区间为 96%。

paragraphs.en: For asymmetric distributions, the authors should be careful not to show in tables or figures symmetric error bars that would yield results that are out of range (e.g., negative error rates).
paragraphs.zh: 对于非对称分布，作者应谨慎避免在表格或图表中展示对称误差棒，因为这可能导致结果超出合理范围（例如，出现负的错误率）。

paragraphs.en: If error bars are reported in tables or plots, the authors should explain in the text how they were calculated and reference the corresponding figures or tables in the text.
paragraphs.zh: 如果表格或图表中报告了误差棒，作者应在正文中解释其计算方法，并在正文中引用相应的图表。

paragraphs.en: Question: For each experiment, does the paper provide sufficient information on the computer resources (type of compute workers, memory, time of execution) needed to reproduce the experiments?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：对于每次实验，该论文是否提供了足够的信息，说明重现这些实验所需的计算资源（计算智能体的类型、内存、执行时间）？

paragraphs.en: Justification: The detailed computational sources are described in Appendix.
paragraphs.zh: 理由：详细的计算来源在附录中有描述。

paragraphs.en: The paper should indicate the type of compute workers CPU or GPU, internal cluster, or cloud provider, including relevant memory and storage.
paragraphs.zh: 论文中应说明计算工作器的类型（CPU 或 GPU）、内部集群或云提供商，并包含相关的内存和存储信息。

paragraphs.en: The paper should provide the amount of compute required for each of the individual experimental runs as well as estimate the total compute.
paragraphs.zh: 该论文应说明每次单独实验运行所需的计算量，并估算总计算量。

paragraphs.en: The paper should disclose whether the full research project required more compute than the experiments reported in the paper (e.g., preliminary or failed experiments that didn’t make it into the paper).
paragraphs.zh: 论文应说明整个研究项目所需的计算资源是否多于论文中报告的那些实验（例如，未纳入论文的初步实验或失败实验）。

paragraphs.en: Question: Does the research conducted in the paper conform, in every respect, with the NeurIPS Code of Ethics https://neurips.cc/public/EthicsGuidelines ?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：该论文中开展的研究是否在各方面均符合 NeurIPS 道德准则 https://neurips.cc/public/EthicsGuidelines？

paragraphs.en: Justification: This paper utilizes only the public datasets for experiments, which are open-access for research purposes. These are no self-collected human data in our experiments.
paragraphs.zh: 理由：本文在实验中仅使用公开数据集，这些数据集可供研究目的免费访问。 我们的实验中没有使用自行收集的人类数据。

sents.en: Justification: This paper utilizes only the public datasets for experiments, which are open-access for research purposes.
sents.zh: 理由：本文在实验中仅使用公开数据集，这些数据集可供研究目的免费访问。

sents.en: These are no self-collected human data in our experiments.
sents.zh: 我们的实验中没有使用自行收集的人类数据。

paragraphs.en: The answer [N/A] means that the authors have not reviewed the NeurIPS Code of Ethics.
paragraphs.zh: 答案 [N/A] 表示作者尚未审阅 NeurIPS 道德准则。

paragraphs.en: If the authors answer [No] , they should explain the special circumstances that require a deviation from the Code of Ethics.
paragraphs.zh: 如果作者回答[否]，他们应解释需要偏离《道德准则》的特殊情况。

paragraphs.en: The authors should make sure to preserve anonymity (e.g., if there is a special consideration due to laws or regulations in their jurisdiction).
paragraphs.zh: 作者应确保保持匿名性（例如，如果其司法管辖区的法律或法规存在特殊考量）。

paragraphs.en: Question: Does the paper discuss both potential positive societal impacts and negative societal impacts of the work performed?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：该论文是否讨论了所开展工作可能带来的积极社会影响和消极社会影响？

paragraphs.en: Justification: The social impacts are discussed in the last section.
paragraphs.zh: 理由：社会影响将在最后一节中讨论。

paragraphs.en: The answer [N/A] means that there is no societal impact of the work performed.
paragraphs.zh: 答案 [N/A] 表示所完成的工作对社会没有影响。

paragraphs.en: If the authors answer [N/A] or [No] , they should explain why their work has no societal impact or why the paper does not address societal impact.
paragraphs.zh: 如果作者回答 [N/A] 或 [否]，他们应解释其工作为何没有社会影响，或该论文为何未涉及社会影响。

paragraphs.en: Examples of negative societal impacts include potential malicious or unintended uses (e.g., disinformation, generating fake profiles, surveillance), fairness considerations (e.g., deployment of technologies that could make decisions that unfairly impact specific groups), privacy considerations, and security considerations.
paragraphs.zh: 负面社会影响的示例包括潜在的恶意或无意用途（例如，虚假信息、生成虚假个人资料、监控）、公平性考量（例如，部署可能对特定群体造成不公平影响的技术决策）、隐私考量以及安全考量。

paragraphs.en: The conference expects that many papers will be foundational research and not tied to particular applications, let alone deployments. However, if there is a direct path to any negative applications, the authors should point it out. For example, it is legitimate to point out that an improvement in the quality of generative models could be used to generate Deepfakes for disinformation. On the other hand, it is not needed to point out that a generic algorithm for optimizing neural networks could enable people to train models that generate Deepfakes faster.
paragraphs.zh: 本次会议期望许多论文都将属于基础研究领域，而非与特定应用挂钩，更不用说实际部署了。 然而，如果存在任何可能导致负面应用的直接路径，作者应当指出这一点。 例如，指出生成式模型质量的提升可能被用于制造虚假信息中的深度伪造内容，这一观点是合理的。 另一方面，则无需指出一种通用的神经网络优化算法可能使人们能够更快地训练出可生成深度伪造内容的模型。

sents.en: The conference expects that many papers will be foundational research and not tied to particular applications, let alone deployments.
sents.zh: 本次会议期望许多论文都将属于基础研究领域，而非与特定应用挂钩，更不用说实际部署了。

sents.en: However, if there is a direct path to any negative applications, the authors should point it out.
sents.zh: 然而，如果存在任何可能导致负面应用的直接路径，作者应当指出这一点。

sents.en: For example, it is legitimate to point out that an improvement in the quality of generative models could be used to generate Deepfakes for disinformation.
sents.zh: 例如，指出生成式模型质量的提升可能被用于制造虚假信息中的深度伪造内容，这一观点是合理的。

sents.en: On the other hand, it is not needed to point out that a generic algorithm for optimizing neural networks could enable people to train models that generate Deepfakes faster.
sents.zh: 另一方面，则无需指出一种通用的神经网络优化算法可能使人们能够更快地训练出可生成深度伪造内容的模型。

paragraphs.en: The authors should consider possible harms that could arise when the technology is being used as intended and functioning correctly, harms that could arise when the technology is being used as intended but gives incorrect results, and harms following from (intentional or unintentional) misuse of the technology.
paragraphs.zh: 作者应考虑该技术按预期使用且正常运行时可能产生的危害、该技术按预期使用但给出错误结果时可能产生的危害，以及因（有意或无意）滥用该技术而导致的危害。

paragraphs.en: If there are negative societal impacts, the authors could also discuss possible mitigation strategies (e.g., gated release of models, providing defenses in addition to attacks, mechanisms for monitoring misuse, mechanisms to monitor how a system learns from feedback over time, improving the efficiency and accessibility of ML).
paragraphs.zh: 如果存在负面社会影响，作者还可以讨论可能的缓解策略（例如，对模型进行限制性发布、在提供攻击方法的同时提供防御措施、建立滥用行为监测机制、建立监测系统随时间从反馈中学习方式的机制，以及提升机器学习技术的效率和可及性）。

paragraphs.en: Question: Does the paper describe safeguards that have been put in place for responsible release of data or models that have a high risk for misuse (e.g., pre-trained language models, image generators, or scraped datasets)?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：该论文是否描述了为确保数据或模型负责任地发布而采取的安全措施？这些数据或模型存在被滥用的较高风险（例如，预训练语言模型、图像生成器或网络爬取的数据集）。

paragraphs.en: Justification: This paper proposes to generate the human grasp, which aims at studying the general interactive patterns and can hardly be used to harm public safety. Though it can foster the deployment of dexterous robots that might result in harmful context, this is more related with robotic breakthroughs and are out of scope of this paper.
paragraphs.zh: 理由：本文提出生成人类抓握动作的方法，旨在研究普遍的交互模式，几乎不可能被用于危害公共安全。 尽管这可能会促进灵巧机器人的部署，而这些机器人或许会在某些情况下造成危害，但这一问题更多与机器人技术的突破相关，超出了本文的研究范围。

sents.en: Justification: This paper proposes to generate the human grasp, which aims at studying the general interactive patterns and can hardly be used to harm public safety.
sents.zh: 理由：本文提出生成人类抓握动作的方法，旨在研究普遍的交互模式，几乎不可能被用于危害公共安全。

sents.en: Though it can foster the deployment of dexterous robots that might result in harmful context, this is more related with robotic breakthroughs and are out of scope of this paper.
sents.zh: 尽管这可能会促进灵巧机器人的部署，而这些机器人或许会在某些情况下造成危害，但这一问题更多与机器人技术的突破相关，超出了本文的研究范围。

paragraphs.en: The answer [N/A] means that the paper poses no such risks.
paragraphs.zh: 答案 [N/A] 表示该论文不存在此类风险。

paragraphs.en: Released models that have a high risk for misuse or dual-use should be released with necessary safeguards to allow for controlled use of the model, for example by requiring that users adhere to usage guidelines or restrictions to access the model or implementing safety filters.
paragraphs.zh: 对于存在较高滥用或双重用途风险已发布的模型，应配备必要的安全保障措施，以实现对该模型的受控使用。例如，可以要求用户遵守使用指南或限制才能访问该模型，或者实施安全过滤器。

paragraphs.en: Datasets that have been scraped from the Internet could pose safety risks. The authors should describe how they avoided releasing unsafe images.
paragraphs.zh: 从互联网上抓取的数据集可能会带来安全风险。 作者应说明他们如何避免发布不安全的图像。

sents.en: Datasets that have been scraped from the Internet could pose safety risks.
sents.zh: 从互联网上抓取的数据集可能会带来安全风险。

sents.en: The authors should describe how they avoided releasing unsafe images.
sents.zh: 作者应说明他们如何避免发布不安全的图像。

paragraphs.en: We recognize that providing effective safeguards is challenging, and many papers do not require this, but we encourage authors to take this into account and make a best faith effort.
paragraphs.zh: 我们认识到，提供有效的保障措施具有挑战性，许多论文也并未提出这一要求，但我们鼓励作者将此纳入考量，并尽最大努力予以实现。

paragraphs.en: Question: Are the creators or original owners of assets (e.g., code, data, models), used in the paper, properly credited and are the license and terms of use explicitly mentioned and properly respected?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：论文中使用的资产（例如代码、数据、模型）的创建者或原始所有者是否得到了适当的署名？其许可证和使用条款是否被明确提及并得到妥善遵守？

paragraphs.en: Justification: The public datasets are properly cited and we use them following their terms of use.
paragraphs.zh: 理由：我们已对公开数据集进行了适当的引用，并遵循其使用条款进行使用。

paragraphs.en: The answer [N/A] means that the paper does not use existing assets.
paragraphs.zh: 答案 [N/A] 表示该论文未使用现有资产。

paragraphs.en: The authors should cite the original paper that produced the code package or dataset.
paragraphs.zh: 作者应引用生成该代码包或数据集的原始论文。

paragraphs.en: The authors should state which version of the asset is used and, if possible, include a URL.
paragraphs.zh: 作者应说明使用了哪个版本的资产，并在可能的情况下附上一个 URL。

paragraphs.en: The name of the license (e.g., CC-BY 4.0) should be included for each asset.
paragraphs.zh: 每个资产都应包含许可证的名称（例如，CC-BY 4.0）。

paragraphs.en: For scraped data from a particular source (e.g., website), the copyright and terms of service of that source should be provided.
paragraphs.zh: 对于从特定来源（例如网站）抓取的数据，应提供该来源的版权和条款与条件。

paragraphs.en: If assets are released, the license, copyright information, and terms of use in the package should be provided. For popular datasets, paperswithcode.com/datasets has curated licenses for some datasets. Their licensing guide can help determine the license of a dataset.
paragraphs.zh: 如果发布资产，应提供包中包含的许可证、版权信息和使用条款。 对于热门数据集，paperswithcode.com/datasets 已为部分数据集整理了许可证。 他们的许可指南可以帮助确定数据集的许可证。

sents.en: If assets are released, the license, copyright information, and terms of use in the package should be provided.
sents.zh: 如果发布资产，应提供包中包含的许可证、版权信息和使用条款。

sents.en: For popular datasets, paperswithcode.com/datasets has curated licenses for some datasets.
sents.zh: 对于热门数据集，paperswithcode.com/datasets 已为部分数据集整理了许可证。

sents.en: Their licensing guide can help determine the license of a dataset.
sents.zh: 他们的许可指南可以帮助确定数据集的许可证。

paragraphs.en: For existing datasets that are re-packaged, both the original license and the license of the derived asset (if it has changed) should be provided.
paragraphs.zh: 对于经过重新打包的现有数据集，应同时提供原始许可证和衍生资产的许可证（如果已变更）。

paragraphs.en: If this information is not available online, the authors are encouraged to reach out to the asset’s creators.
paragraphs.zh: 如果这些信息在网上无法获取，建议作者联系该资产的创作者。

paragraphs.en: Question: Are new assets introduced in the paper well documented and is the documentation provided alongside the assets?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：论文中引入的新资产是否得到了充分说明？提供的文档是否与这些资产一同给出？

paragraphs.en: Justification: This paper does not contribute new assets.
paragraphs.zh: 理由：本文未引入新的资产。

paragraphs.en: The answer [N/A] means that the paper does not release new assets.
paragraphs.zh: 答案 [N/A] 表示该论文并未发布新的资产。

paragraphs.en: Researchers should communicate the details of the dataset/code/model as part of their submissions via structured templates. This includes details about training, license, limitations, etc.
paragraphs.zh: 研究人员应在提交成果时，通过结构化模板说明数据集、代码或模型的相关细节。 这包括训练信息、许可协议、局限性等方面的内容。

sents.en: Researchers should communicate the details of the dataset/code/model as part of their submissions via structured templates.

paragraphs.en: The paper should discuss whether and how consent was obtained from people whose asset is used.
paragraphs.zh: 论文应讨论是否以及如何从其资产被使用的人那里获得了同意。

paragraphs.en: At submission time, remember to anonymize your assets (if applicable). You can either create an anonymized URL or include an anonymized zip file.
paragraphs.zh: 提交时，请记得对您的资产进行匿名化处理（如适用）。 您可以创建一个匿名化 URL，或者附上一个经过匿名处理的压缩文件。

paragraphs.en: Crowdsourcing and research with human subjects
paragraphs.zh: 众包与涉及人类受试者的研究

paragraphs.en: Question: For crowdsourcing experiments and research with human subjects, does the paper include the full text of instructions given to participants and screenshots, if applicable, as well as details about compensation (if any)?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：对于涉及人类受试者的众包实验和研究，该论文是否包含了提供给参与者的完整说明文本以及（如适用）的屏幕截图，同时还说明了补偿细节（如有）？

paragraphs.en: Justification: There is no user study in this paper.
paragraphs.zh: 理由：本文中没有用户研究。

paragraphs.en: The answer [N/A] means that the paper does not involve crowdsourcing nor research with human subjects.
paragraphs.zh: 答案 [N/A] 表示该论文既不涉及众包，也不涉及以人类为对象的研究。

paragraphs.en: Including this information in the supplemental material is fine, but if the main contribution of the paper involves human subjects, then as much detail as possible should be included in the main paper.
paragraphs.zh: 将此类信息包含在补充材料中是可以的，但如果论文的主要贡献涉及人类受试者，则应在主文中尽可能详细地说明。

paragraphs.en: According to the NeurIPS Code of Ethics, workers involved in data collection, curation, or other labor should be paid at least the minimum wage in the country of the data collector.
paragraphs.zh: 根据 NeurIPS 道德准则，参与数据收集、整理或其他劳动的工作人员，其薪酬应至少达到数据收集者所在国家的最低工资标准。

paragraphs.en: Institutional review board (IRB) approvals or equivalent for research with human subjects
paragraphs.zh: 涉及人类受试者的研究须获得机构审查委员会（IRB）批准或同等批准

paragraphs.en: Question: Does the paper describe potential risks incurred by study participants, whether such risks were disclosed to the subjects, and whether Institutional Review Board (IRB) approvals (or an equivalent approval/review based on the requirements of your country or institution) were obtained?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：该论文是否描述了研究参与者可能面临的风险？这些风险是否已向受试者披露？是否获得了机构审查委员会（IRB）的批准（或根据您所在国家/地区或机构的要求获得的同等批准/审查）？

paragraphs.en: Justification: This paper does not include crowdsourcing or research with human subjects.
paragraphs.zh: 理由：本文未涉及众包或涉及人类受试者的研究。

paragraphs.en: Depending on the country in which research is conducted, IRB approval (or equivalent) may be required for any human subjects research. If you obtained IRB approval, you should clearly state this in the paper.
paragraphs.zh: 研究所在哪个国家，可能就需要针对任何涉及人类受试者的研究获得伦理审查委员会（IRB）的批准（或同等批准）。 如果你获得了伦理审查委员会（IRB）的批准，就应该在论文中明确说明这一点。

sents.en: Depending on the country in which research is conducted, IRB approval (or equivalent) may be required for any human subjects research.
sents.zh: 研究所在哪个国家，可能就需要针对任何涉及人类受试者的研究获得伦理审查委员会（IRB）的批准（或同等批准）。

sents.en: If you obtained IRB approval, you should clearly state this in the paper.
sents.zh: 如果你获得了伦理审查委员会（IRB）的批准，就应该在论文中明确说明这一点。

paragraphs.en: We recognize that the procedures for this may vary significantly between institutions and locations, and we expect authors to adhere to the NeurIPS Code of Ethics and the guidelines for their institution.
paragraphs.zh: 我们认识到，相关流程可能因机构和地点的不同而存在显著差异，因此我们期望作者遵守 NeurIPS 道德准则及其所在机构的指导方针。

paragraphs.en: For initial submissions, do not include any information that would break anonymity (if applicable), such as the institution conducting the review.
paragraphs.zh: 对于初次提交的材料，请勿包含任何可能破坏匿名性的信息（如适用），例如负责评审的机构。

paragraphs.en: Question: Does the paper describe the usage of LLMs if it is an important, original, or non-standard component of the core methods in this research? Note that if the LLM is used only for writing, editing, or formatting purposes and does not impact the core methodology, scientific rigor, or originality of the research, declaration is not required.
paragraphs.zh: 问题：如果大型语言模型（LLM）是这项研究核心方法中重要、原创或非标准的组成部分，论文是否描述了其使用方式？ 请注意，如果 LLM 仅用于写作、编辑或格式调整，且未对研究的核心理论方法、科学严谨性或原创性产生影响，则无需声明。

paragraphs.zh: 理由：该方法的主要框架基于潜在扩散模型，而非大型语言模型（LLM）。

paragraphs.en: The answer [N/A] means that the core method development in this research does not involve LLMs as any important, original, or non-standard components.
paragraphs.zh: 答案 [N/A] 表示本研究中的核心方法开发并未将 LLM 作为任何重要、原创或非标准的组成部分。

paragraphs.en: Please refer to our LLM policy in the NeurIPS handbook for what should or should not be described.
paragraphs.zh: 有关哪些内容应当或不应进行描述，请参阅 NeurIPS 手册中我们的 LLM 政策。
